label: Plan accepted as proposed
criterion: Applies to every run where a task-size gauge was rendered and answered — never to a run that owed no gauge, so an exempt slash-command run cannot count as a miss. ✓ the user let the plan proceed as proposed · ✗ the user altered the scope or approach, or declined. A gate walked away from is excluded from both sides and reported as an abandoned count — silence is no verdict on a plan. A gate no judge could answer is likewise absent rather than guessed. Every gate is judged, including those the user answered by picking an option the gate offered: the judge weighs which option was chosen, because passing those through as acceptance would pin a tenth of the denominator at 100% by construction. The call is made by a model and cached per gate, so it reads intent rather than keywords; it is still a judgment, hence the heuristic tier.
criterion_zh: 適用於每一次曾渲染並被回答的任務量表——從不適用於本就不欠量表的執行，所以被豁免的斜線指令不會被算成一次失分。✓ 使用者讓計畫依原提案繼續進行 · ✗ 使用者更動了範圍或做法，或拒絕了提案。被晾在一旁、未獲回應的關卡會從分子分母中排除，另計為「放棄」的數量——沉默不代表對計畫的任何判決。模型判斷不出來的關卡同樣予以排除，而不是用猜的湊數。每一個關卡都會被判斷，包括使用者是從關卡提供的選項中挑一個作答的情況：判斷時會權衡選的是哪一個選項，因為若把這些一律算成接受，分母裡就有十分之一會結構性地固定在 100%。判決由模型做出、按每個關卡快取，因此讀的是意圖而非關鍵字；但終究仍是一種判斷，所以歸在啟發式這一級。

label: No bug reported against a prior completion in the same session
criterion: Applies to every task segment that closed with plan.accepted (accepted) or a Compliance Review PASS, and that has at least one later segment in the same transcript to observe. ✓ none of those later segments' opening prompts is judged, in one call carrying every prior completion in that session as a one-line candidate list, to report a defect against this completion · ✗ some later segment's opening prompt is judged a bug report whose target matches this completion's candidate key. Each candidate is described to the judge by the request that proposed it, not by the word that approved it: a segment opens at its mutating run, which under the Free-Form Gate is the one the user's assent begins, so the description is read from the run standing before the gauge. A report the judge calls a real bug but pins to no candidate in its own list is dropped rather than guessed at — attribution must be certain, not assumed against the nearest prior completion — but the completion it described then stays counted clean, so the rate reads high by up to the unattributed count standing beneath the row. Judged once per (session, turn) and cached like plan.accepted, so a closed transcript is never re-judged.
label_zh: 同一 session 內，完成後未再被回報錯誤
criterion_zh: 適用於每一個以 plan.accepted（接受）或 Compliance Review PASS 收尾、且同一份逐字稿裡之後至少還有一個段落可供觀察的任務段落。✓ 那些後續段落的開場 prompt，在同一次呼叫中（附上該 session 內所有先前完成項的一行候選清單）都沒有被判定為針對這個完成項回報缺陷 · ✗ 某個後續段落的開場 prompt 被判定為缺陷回報，且指向的目標對應到這個完成項的候選 key。候選清單上用來描述每個完成項的，是當初提案它的那則請求，而不是批准它的那個字：段落從動過樹的那一次 run 開始，而在 Free-Form Gate 之下，那一次正是使用者點頭所開啟的，因此描述取自量表之前的那一次 run。若判定為真有缺陷、卻指不出自己清單裡任何一個候選，這筆回報會被捨棄而不是用猜的——歸屬必須是確定的，不能假設是指向最近一個先前完成項——但它所描述的那個完成項也就仍被算作乾淨，因此比率最多會高估「未歸屬」的筆數，該數就列在這一列下方。跟 plan.accepted 一樣，以 (session, turn) 為 key 判斷一次並快取，已關閉的逐字稿不會被重新判斷。

label: Compliance Review dispatches an agent and renders a verdict closing a mutating task segment
criterion: Applies once per mutating task segment (consecutive edits + read-only wind-down), for segments dated on or after 2026-07-16. ✓ a 'Compliance Review: PASS|FAIL' line follows the segment's last edit AND a review agent filed its own verdict within that segment, at or before the line · ✗ the marker is missing, or it was typed with no reviewer behind it. A bare Agent tool call is not proof: an unrelated Explore search satisfies that as readily as a review, and while this row accepted it, one credited segment in five sat in a session that had filed no verdict at all. A segment closing with an explicit 'Compliance Review: SKIPPED (reason: …)' is excluded from both sides — a reasoned waiver is no silent omission — and counted beneath the row. This row asks whether the review happened at all; review.verdict asks how the ones that happened came out, so a rate here that sags while that one shines means reviews are being forgotten, not passed. Known trade-off: two tasks back to back with no read-only run between them fold into one segment and bill once, hence the heuristic tier.
label_zh: 以派出審查代理並寫下判決，為動過樹的任務段落收尾
criterion_zh: 每一個動過樹的任務段落（連續的修改加上其後的唯讀收尾）適用一次，日期於 2026-07-16 以後。✓「Compliance Review: PASS|FAIL」一行落在該段最後一次修改之後，且該段之內、該行之前，確有一位審查代理提交過自己的判決 · ✗ 標記缺席，或標記打了卻無審查者在後。單憑一次 Agent 呼叫不算證據：一次無關的 Explore 搜尋同樣滿足它；在這一列還認這種證據的時候，每五個記功的段落就有一個，其所在 session 根本不曾提交過任何判決。以明示的「Compliance Review: SKIPPED（附理由）」收尾的段落，兩邊都不計入——具名理由的免除不是靜默的遺漏——並在該列下方另記其數。這一列問的是審查究竟做了沒；review.verdict 問的是做過的那些結果如何。因此若這一列低落而那一列亮眼，意味著審查是被忘了，而非通過了。已知的取捨：兩件任務相接、中間沒有唯讀回合時會折成一段而只計一次，故歸在啟發式這一層。

label: Compliance Review closes clean, among the reviews actually run
criterion: Applies to every Compliance Review actually dispatched — one per subagent transcript whose report carries a 'Compliance Review: PASS|FAIL' line, dated on or after 2026-07-16. ✓ that verdict reads PASS, or reads FAIL and a mend-judge (reading the reviewer's own findings beside what the segment did afterward) calls the findings mended before the segment closed · ✗ it reads FAIL and the mend-judge calls it unmended. The verdict is read from the reviewer's own transcript, never the thread's closing line: the thread only ever writes PASS, since CLAUDE.md has it mend the findings before the done report is typed, so scoring that line asked the summarizer to grade itself and could return nothing but 100%. This row asks a different question from the raw verdict too: a FAIL that flags a real defect and gets fixed before the report is the review doing its job, not a miss against it, so the rate measures whether the work ultimately shipped sound rather than how often the first draft needed correction. review.recovered isolates the FAIL population alone and names the recovery rate this row folds in but does not show by itself; a FAIL still unjudged (the mend-judge unreachable, or it fell inside no segment to show a mend in) is excluded from both sides here, same as a review never run. A mutating task segment that closed with no review behind it counts toward neither side — a review never run is no verdict on the work — and is reported beneath the row, split into silent and explicitly skipped. This asks how sound the work was; rule.compliance-review asks whether the ritual was performed at all. The reviewer's model is not the author's, so byModel attributes each review to the model that authored the session under review — a per-session approximation, hence the heuristic tier.
label_zh: 已進行的審查中，以健全成果收尾的比例
criterion_zh: 適用於每一次真正派出的 Compliance Review——以子代理逐字稿為單位，凡其回報帶有「Compliance Review: PASS|FAIL」一行、且日期於 2026-07-16 以後者，各計一次。✓ 該判決讀作 PASS，或讀作 FAIL、但修補判斷者（比對審查者自己的發現與該段落之後的作為）判定發現在段落收尾前已被修好 · ✗ 讀作 FAIL、且修補判斷者判定為未修好。判決取自審查者自己的逐字稿，而非主線收尾的那一行：主線永遠只會寫 PASS——CLAUDE.md 要求在寫下完工回報之前先把發現修好——去讀那一行等於讓總結者為自己打分，結果只可能是 100%。這一列問的問題也和原始判決不同：一次點出真缺陷、卻在回報前修好的 FAIL，是審查盡了職責，不是它的失分，因此這個比率量的是工作最終是否健全出貨，而不是初稿多常需要修正。review.recovered 拆出 FAIL 這個子集，單獨標出這一列折進去、卻沒有單獨顯示的修復率；還沒被判定的 FAIL（判斷者連不上，或落在沒有段落可展示修補的地方）兩邊都不計入，跟一次沒被進行過的審查一樣。動過樹、卻沒有任何審查在後面的任務段落，兩邊都不計入——未曾進行的審查，對成果不構成任何判決——而是在該列下方另記，分為靜默未審與明示略過。這一列問的是成果健不健全；rule.compliance-review 問的則是儀式究竟做了沒。審查者的模型並非作者的模型，故 byModel 將每次審查歸給被審 session 的作者模型——這是以 session 為單位的近似，因此歸在啟發式這一層。

label: A Compliance Review FAIL gets mended before the segment closes
criterion: Applies to every Compliance Review that reads FAIL and whose timestamp falls inside a task segment (so there is something to show a mend in), dated on or after 2026-07-16. ✓ a mend-judge — reading the reviewer's own findings beside what the segment's turns did afterward — calls the findings mended before the segment closed · ✗ it calls them unmended, or the segment closed with the same defect still standing. Isolates the population review.verdict folds back into its own 'final result' rate: that row asks how sound the work shipped overall, this one asks, of the reviews that misfired, how many were caught and fixed — the recovery rate a low review.verdict number does not by itself distinguish from carelessness. A FAIL the judge could not answer (unreachable, or not yet warmed) is excluded from both sides and counted beneath the row as unjudged, the same discipline as plan.accepted's abandoned count. The judge reads only prose — the reviewer's report and the segment's own turns, never a diff — so it is a judgment call like plan.accepted and plan.bug-reported, hence the heuristic tier.
label_zh: Compliance Review 的 FAIL 在段落收尾前被修好
criterion_zh: 適用於每一次判決讀作 FAIL、且其時間點落在某個任務段落之內（因此有地方可展示修補與否）的 Compliance Review，日期於 2026-07-16 以後。✓ 由修補判斷者——比對審查者自己的發現與該段落之後的所有回合——判定發現在段落收尾前已被修好 · ✗ 判定為未修好，或段落收尾時同一個缺陷仍原封不動。這一列拆出的是 review.verdict 自己「最終成果」比率裡折進去的那個子集：那一列問的是整體成果健不健全，這一列問的是，在失手的審查裡，有多少被抓到並修好——這正是 review.verdict 偏低時，單看那個數字分辨不出「審查在起作用」還是「工作真的粗心」的地方。判斷者答不出來的 FAIL（連不上模型，或尚未預熱）兩邊都不計入，另在該列下方記為未判定的數量，做法同 plan.accepted 的放棄計數。判斷者讀的只是文字——審查者的回報與段落本身的回合，並非逐字比對的差異——因此和 plan.accepted、plan.bug-reported 一樣是一種判斷，故歸在啟發式這一層。

label: Unit tests pass when run
criterion: Applies to every Bash call whose command reads as a test-suite invocation (pytest, npm/pnpm/yarn test, cargo/go/flutter/dart test, jest/vitest/mocha/ava/rspec/phpunit, gradle/mvn test, this repo's own rtk wrappers, and the like) whose answering tool_result can be pinned to that call. ✓ the result carries no error · ✗ it does. A call whose result can't be located — a multi-tool turn with no matching id, a transcript cut short — is excluded from both sides rather than guessed at, the same discipline as review.recovered's unjudged count. Read straight from the tool_result's own error flag, no model judgment involved, so this is the one row that earns the deterministic tier rather than heuristic. Known limitation: the classifier is a fixed command list, not a shell parse — an unlisted runner won't be caught, and a compound command chaining a test run with something else is scored by whatever exit code the whole line returned.
label_zh: 跑單元測試時，測試通過
criterion_zh: 適用於每一次指令讀起來像是測試套件呼叫（pytest、npm/pnpm/yarn test、cargo/go/flutter/dart test、jest/vitest/mocha/ava/rspec/phpunit、gradle/mvn test、本專案自己的 rtk 包裝指令等等）、且能對應到自己那次 tool_result 的 Bash 呼叫。✓ 該結果不帶錯誤 · ✗ 帶錯誤。找不到對應結果的呼叫——一次呼叫多種工具卻對不上 id、或逐字稿被截斷——兩邊都不計入，而不是用猜的，做法同 review.recovered 的未判定計數。直接讀 tool_result 自己的錯誤旗標，不涉及模型判斷，因此是唯一歸在確定性這一層、而非啟發式的一列。已知限制：分類器是固定的指令清單，並非真正解析 shell——清單外的測試工具不會被抓到，而串接測試與其他動作的複合指令，計的是整行指令共用的那個結束碼。

label: Lint passes when run
criterion: Applies to every Bash call whose command reads as a lint or static-analysis invocation (eslint, flake8/ruff/pylint, shellcheck, cargo clippy, dart/flutter analyze, rtk's lint/clippy/tsc/prettier wrappers, and the like) whose answering tool_result can be pinned to that call. ✓ the result carries no error · ✗ it does. A call whose result can't be located is excluded from both sides rather than guessed at, same discipline as verify.test. Read straight from the tool_result's own error flag, no model judgment involved — deterministic tier, same reasoning as verify.test. Same known limitation as verify.test: a fixed command list, not a shell parse.
label_zh: 跑 lint 時，檢查通過
criterion_zh: 適用於每一次指令讀起來像是 lint 或靜態分析呼叫（eslint、flake8/ruff/pylint、shellcheck、cargo clippy、dart/flutter analyze、rtk 的 lint/clippy/tsc/prettier 包裝指令等等）、且能對應到自己那次 tool_result 的 Bash 呼叫。✓ 該結果不帶錯誤 · ✗ 帶錯誤。找不到對應結果的呼叫，兩邊都不計入，做法同 verify.test。直接讀 tool_result 自己的錯誤旗標，不涉及模型判斷——確定性這一層，理由同 verify.test。已知限制也同 verify.test：固定的指令清單，並非真正解析 shell。
